provenance.description: Pointer back to the raw evidence this normalized record was derived from. Any field EdgeLab could not determine is null, never fabricated.

sourceSystem.description: e.g. kalshi_registry_snapshots, kalshi_discovery, bets_json, data_bets_json, pipeline_recommendations, clv_from_snapshot, f5_settlement, manual_entry

sourceFile.description: Repo-relative path to the raw/upstream file this record was ingested from

sourceKey.description: Key/index/ticker used to locate this record within sourceFile, when the file is not itself one-record-per-line

capturedAt.description: When the underlying evidence was captured/observed (may differ from ingestedAt)

ingestedAt.description: When EdgeLab's ingestion produced this normalized record

sport.description: Phase 2 future-proofing field (docs/EDGELAB_PHASE2_DESIGN.md §2.1). Optional and nullable so every pre-Phase-2 record (which never carries this field at all) stays valid under this schema version -- absent is not an error. Every EdgeLab writer as of this phase is MLB-only and sets this explicitly to 'MLB' rather than leaving it null, but a reader must still treat a genuinely missing value as 'MLB' (see the analytics layer's COALESCE(sport, 'MLB'), never assume every record was written post-this-change.

platform.description: Phase 2 future-proofing field, same rationale as 'sport'. Distinct from provenance.sourceSystem (which internal EdgeLab script/module produced the record) -- this is which external trading venue/sportsbook the market itself belongs to. Every EdgeLab writer as of this phase is Kalshi-only and sets this explicitly to 'KALSHI'; a reader must treat a missing value as 'KALSHI' (COALESCE(platform, 'KALSHI')).
